Founded in 1960 in Belém, Brazil,
Extrafarma
operates major pharmaceutical retail and drug distribution networks headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. It sells prescription drugs, generics, cosmetics, and personal care products, and is owned by
Pague Menos
Bloomberg.com
What the Company Does
Operates a large chain of retail drugstores across multiple Brazilian states.
Distributes and sells generic and brand-name prescription drugs, over-the-counter medication, dermatological items, cosmetics, vitamins, baby care essentials, and hygiene products.
Bloomberg.com

Extrafarma
(acquired and integrated by
Farmácias Pague Menos
) offers over 1,300 private-label and exclusive items spanning vitamins, hygiene, and baby care. It partners with major national and multinational pharmaceutical laboratories (such as EMS, Eurofarma, Sanofi, and Bayer) to distribute branded, generic, and OTC medicines.
